rules.requirement: Rewrite a whole lesson from its brief with a fresh skeleton and fresh examples. Edit old lines only for a requested touch-up.
rules.verification: Scope matches request.

rules.requirement: Before any whole-script writing or rewriting, ask whether a lead magnet is promoted unless already answered. If yes, require its name, viewer function and contents; never infer contents from its name. A paragraph/section touch-up does not trigger this question.
rules.verification: Blocking preflight; preserve known answer.

rules.requirement: Skeleton includes hook in three beats, one or two sentences per section idea, one example/scene, close, optional story location, three confirmed magnet slots and all idea-to-mechanics turns. If idea needs more than a paragraph, simplify and let example carry it.
rules.verification: Each section has one teaching point; all slots explicit.

rules.requirement: Each section has a signpost, grounding line, short idea, movement and closing line/handoff. Use B1–B12 or Parker for entrance, B13 grounding, B14/B3 close.
rules.verification: Section contract complete.

rules.requirement: Inside sections use a movement device every two to four sentences, never the same device twice in a row. Mix B15–B30. Maximum four sentences without a move is retained; do not silently downgrade this quota.
rules.verification: Track movement spans and types; final review confirms semantic function, not keyword presence.

rules.requirement: Keep one running example, image or number and call back to it across the script. When there is a story it usually supplies that example. Open loops must be genuine and paid off by giving the thing.
rules.verification: Example and loop ledgers resolve.

rules.requirement: Every paragraph picks up from the previous paragraph with a spoken link. Introduce a thing before naming it, then define it, then show it.
rules.verification: Inspect every join and introduced entity.

rules.requirement: Match signposts to lesson position. Early entrances set up and announce; warnings, rankings and step labels follow established parts. Judge with the paragraphs before and after.
rules.verification: Context window required.

rules.requirement: Say concrete events that cause feelings; never announce the feeling with labels such as here is the bit that stings.
rules.verification: Semantic concreteness review.

rules.requirement: Do not use I said I would show you, remember I said, because I said or equivalent announcements of a routine payoff. Give the payoff directly.
rules.verification: Pattern scan plus semantic review.

rules.requirement: Every pain and result is a concrete event, spoken response or inbox occurrence in the audience world. Replace vague outcomes using Part C.
rules.verification: Concrete result, not insight/mechanism/identity alone.

rules.requirement: Do not repeat the same pain/result wording in a lesson. Rotate the relevant A/K family. Callbacks retain the referent while varying wording.
rules.verification: Repeated phrase review with referent ledger.

rules.requirement: Signpost pull is pain, result, stakes or question in the line or next line. So you can / so you do not occurs in no more than one signpost in three and never adjacent signposts.
rules.verification: Count and adjacency; for fewer than three signposts flag applicability instead of inventing a rounding rule.

rules.requirement: Do not make signposts about the mechanism, presenter, meta diagnosis, insight/understanding as prize or something the viewer must decode.
rules.verification: Check every signpost in context.

rules.requirement: Hook has opener, quick authority, then I will show you one to three things; at least one Parker line; about 50–70 words. Scene/build-up belongs in first section.
rules.verification: Three beats, promises/count, word count.

rules.requirement: No download, subscribe or click CTA straight after hook; first real value comes first.
rules.verification: First value precedes first CTA.

rules.requirement: Every idea-to-tangible-mechanics turn uses a Parker line: tangible thing, result and relevant objection. No forcing an objection when none fits.
rules.verification: Mechanics-turn coverage.

rules.requirement: At most one main story, optional. Unannounced, connective start after grounding signpost, pain before scene, thought behind beats, mechanism withheld until handoff and later callbacks.
rules.verification: Story count and beat ledger.

rules.requirement: Use two or three subtle client signals per full script; no other offer detail.
rules.verification: Count retained; missing factual support blocks affected signals rather than fabrication.

rules.requirement: A selected confirmed magnet is mentioned three times after initial value, around middle and around 80 percent. Sell result rather than contents, each with clear free-description CTA.
rules.verification: Exactly three or zero when none; approximate positions reported.

rules.requirement: Close follows core lesson without summary or wrap-up, opens next genuine curiosity gap and sends to next video/lesson.
rules.verification: No recap; current lesson complete; next resource grounded.

rules.requirement: Neutral explanatory/result lines are rewritten toward audience pain or result, rather than saying merely that something is effective.
rules.verification: Review neutral claims without deleting necessary definitions.

rules.requirement: Parker line names a tangible counted item where count is true; outcome in viewer world; optional spoken even if/even when/without clause. Do not reveal mechanism or unexplained lesson names in the promise.
rules.verification: Count matches teaching; objection genuine.

rules.requirement: At least one Parker line in hook and one at every mechanics turn, usually two to four total. Never adjacent Parker lines or repeated wording; second promise of same thing is more specific.
rules.verification: Retain usual 2–4 guidance and mandatory turn coverage; conflict flagged if structure makes both impossible.

rules.requirement: Use relevant bracket-bank objections; omit forced ones. Avoid large homework-like counts and mechanisms posed as prizes.
rules.verification: Promise checked against rejection examples and objection bank.

rules.requirement: Hook opener is curiosity, audience pain question or bold statement, no preamble/have you ever wondered. Authority must be true: supplied scale is more than 80,000 professionals and over 9,500 five-star reviews. Other claims need confirmation; lived pain alone does not establish expertise.
rules.verification: Verify approved facts; block publication or use marked placeholder if unconfirmed, never silently invent authority.

rules.requirement: Hook promises fit title/thumbnail, vary shape, are each speakable in one breath and describe viewer payoff rather than watching the production. Aim under 25 seconds as well as about 50–70 words.
rules.verification: Word and timing estimate plus read-aloud check; timing tolerance not fabricated.

rules.requirement: Story goes either after first segment has set lesson up, or later to overturn a belief blocking action. Later setup names belief and useful outcome. Never announce a story.
rules.verification: Approved location and grounded entrance.

rules.requirement: Story has eight ordered beats: pain before scene; wrong approach and thought; failure/bind; noticed cause leading to turn; action with expanded doubt; result and why feared outcome did not happen; missing practical piece; Parker handoff to teaching. Let beats breathe, not a form with one line each.
rules.verification: All eight meaningful beats and causal links.

rules.requirement: After story include at least two callbacks in different shapes and treat it as running example. No magnet mention inside story; move first mention after story if necessary.
rules.verification: Two post-story callbacks and CTA exclusion.

rules.requirement: First magnet mention usually 25–35 percent after first value: shortest, problem/challenge → solution → CTA. Second around 50 percent after core reveal: doing it yourself is difficult, magnet helps. Third around 80 percent after main lesson: result without building from scratch. Each varied CTA says free in description/download now; never list features.
rules.verification: Three distinct jobs, actual content support, relative word-position estimates.

rules.requirement: Client signals spread out, never in back-to-back sections or same paragraph as magnet CTA. They are swapped audience/client signposts or client value promises. No programme, price, booking call or offer link. Specific results require testimonials or confirmation; otherwise marked placeholder. Private client calls are unnamed and unrecognisable.
rules.verification: Placement, privacy and factual ledger checks.

rules.requirement: Explain audience situation first, concept second and briefly. State formula once then phrases; do not repeat formula or identical objection handling for each phrase.
rules.verification: One explanation, distinct examples.

rules.requirement: Close is at most four short beats: new gap, one/two lines on it, needed thing and value-bearing next-video send. Next resource addresses real prerequisite or new problem; viewer still received whole promised lesson.
rules.verification: Four beats maximum; no manufactured missing core lesson.

rules.requirement: Close forbids ending/recap phrases: so that is the whole thing, to wrap up, before you go, that is it for today, thanks for watching, I hope this helped, that is the next video, there is one thing I did not tell you, all of that works inside the conversation but; no covered-topics list.
rules.verification: Forbidden phrase and semantic wrap-up review.

rules.requirement: Select audience bank Part A first; deeper sources only as needed; selected source references do not grant authority to invent content.
rules.verification: Reference provenance recorded.

rules.requirement: No em dashes; restructure sentences.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: Never use quiet, quietly, land, landed, honest or honestly; never call a meeting the room; remove vague Part C words.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No it is not X it is Y or you are not doing X you are doing Y contrasts.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No Same X Different Y / Same X Same Y fragment pairs.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No signalling surprise: surprisingly, more than you would think, contrary to what most people believe.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: Do not tell viewer something is commonly missed or most people do not realise it.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No here is why this matters; say what matters.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No fragmented lists; use flowing sentences. Short spoken answers to questions remain allowed.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: No colons splitting a spoken sentence.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: Join consequential sentences with comma and conjunction.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: British spelling, grade 12 reading level, smart-person conversational register.
rules.verification: Global style lint + human/read-aloud semantic check.

rules.requirement: Before handback run entire original final checklist, including contextual signs, four-sentence move ceiling, running example, hooks, stories, client/magnet placements, close, joins and house style.
rules.verification: Every applicable rule reported pass/fail/blocked/not_applicable; no silent waiver.

rules.requirement: Audience is capable professionals lacking recognition, decisions or progression; blend senior and less-senior scenes without splitting into two addressed groups.
rules.verification: Audience relevance.

rules.requirement: Use all 24 frustration/result families A1–A14/K1–K10 as selectable banks, all B1–B31 as selectable movement forms, and Part C as prohibited-vagueness rewrite guidance.
rules.verification: Select by actual pain and role; do not require all families/devices in every script.

rules.requirement: Write to common frustration rather than verbatim identifiable client story; moments rather than mechanisms in promises; preserve both audience profiles and their objections.
rules.verification: Anonymised audience synthesis; relevant profile and objection.

rules.requirement: Audience explicitly rejects identity promises, promotion guarantees, voice/body-language training claims, hype/hustle urgency, unlock/transform/master. Product contents require correct product identity.
rules.verification: No guarantee or unverified product promise.

rules.requirement: Magnet index is an inventory of draft choices only. Ten rows conflict with stated total nine and built-asset summary. Require chosen magnet contents and availability.
rules.verification: No inferred download or live status.

rules.requirement: Use tangible curiosity plus outcome plus relevant objection. Do not import Parker hype, checkout layouts, proof, urgency or prices into scripts. Source itself says genuine urgency only.
rules.verification: Craft adaptation only; original audience-specific wording.

rules.requirement: Curiosity bank: broad pain, tangible item, true count, concrete outcome, relevant objection, no hype or unexplained terms. Four-to-eight page bullets is sales-page scope, not mandatory video count. Masterclass has no swipe file per this source; verify product identity.
rules.verification: Do not import page-format/product-specific requirements indiscriminately.

rules.requirement: Use movement archive as selective craft evidence. Retain its section payoff, grounding, simple teaching, varied questions, proof and callbacks; never import author biography, sales figures, tool claims or distinctive source wording as Josh facts.
rules.verification: Original wording, factual provenance and bounded retrieval.

rules.requirement: All factual and biographical claims require approved evidence; invented examples are labelled hypothetical; private details excluded. Current user request wins over reference text. Unresolved conflict becomes a decision, never a silent relaxation.
rules.verification: Claim ledger + conflict ledger.

rules.requirement: Each pass may edit only its declared spans, against current document version. Return proposed patches with exact old text; reject stale/overlapping patches; never auto-overwrite unaccepted user changes.
rules.verification: Patch/version validation.

rules.requirement: For a YouTube video, start from a selected/approved title and thumbnail concept as a pair. Record the shared curiosity question and the concrete payoff the video must deliver. If absent, develop packaging concepts first and obtain selection before full-script drafting; never invent an unrelated script promise. Course lessons and narrow edits must record applicability rather than impose unrelated YouTube packaging.
rules.verification: Packaging selected, curiosity and payoff recorded, all hook/body promises traced to it.

rules.requirement: Source governing goal: conversational movement around simple teaching for this audience; house style is the explicit exception. Source says a rule that makes a line flatter, repetitive or formulaic should yield to that goal. Preserve this priority statement AND the explicit numeric rules: if they conflict, surface the tension and proposed repair/exception rather than silently weakening quotas. Use original language and general techniques rather than copying a named creator.
rules.verification: Whole-script natural-flow assessment; any conflict with numeric rules recorded for explicit decision.
